messages:
caroline_oncall: Quick heads-up: Redis hot-shard rebalance scheduled SAT 01:00-02:00 UTC. Purpose: reduce cross-az KV reads and stabilize tail latency. Expect short p99 blips (~30-90s) during shard moves.

owen_sre: Which clusters? Any tenant impact?

caroline_oncall: Target clusters: kv-main-prod (primary), kv-edge-west. We'll rebalance hot prefixes only. Tenant-facing impact: non-paid routes may see transient latency; enterprise/dedicated unaffected.

nina_infra: Operational note: we'll throttle rebalances to 5 concurrent shard moves per-cluster and monitor replica sync lag. If replica-lag > 2s or replica-sync-fails >1, pause.

tom_pm: Support will need a short template.

caroline_oncall: Draft blurb: "Planned maintenance: internal cache rebalance may cause brief increases in latency for some routes between 01:00-02:00 UTC. No action required unless errors persist."

owen_sre: Abort criteria: sustained error-rate >0.6% for 5m, replica lag >10s for >2m, or control-plane 5xx >1% for 3m. If triggered we stop new moves and let current moves finish.

nina_infra: Commands in runbook: `redis-cli --cluster reshard ...`, `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/reshard-controller --replicas=0` to pause. Metrics tags: maintenance=redis_rebalance, synthetic=false.

srebot: scheduled: maintenance-#7992 created by caroline_oncall for 2024-11-09T01:00Z->2024-11-09T02:00Z

caroline_oncall: TL;DR: bridge 00:45-02:30 UTC, support blurb posted, abort criteria in runbook, paid tiers unaffected. Post-op note within 24h. Ping me on pager for any urgent issues.
